entities.name: 5GSM STATUS
entities.description: A 5GSM message used to report certain error conditions detected upon receipt of 5GSM protocol data. Can be sent by both the network and the UE.

entities.name: 5GSM status procedure
entities.description: Procedure for reporting error conditions using the 5GSM STATUS message. Can be initiated by either UE or network.

entities.name: Error conditions detected
entities.description: Certain error conditions detected upon receipt of 5GSM protocol data that trigger the sending of 5GSM STATUS message.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that can send or receive 5GSM STATUS messages.

entities.name: SMF
entities.description: Session Management Function that can send or receive 5GSM STATUS messages.

relations.description: The 5GSM status procedure involves sending the 5GSM STATUS message.
Detection of error conditions triggers the sending of 5GSM STATUS message.
UE can send 5GSM STATUS message when error conditions are detected.
SMF can send 5GSM STATUS message when error conditions are detected.
5GSM STATUS message can be sent to UE by SMF.
5GSM STATUS message can be sent to SMF by UE.
